title: Dispatcher context copies read 16 bytes from 4- and 8-byte contexts

references.location: MOVDQU at RVA 3A02; second wide copy at RVA 3DE2

description: The dispatcher reads 16 bytes from public 4- or 8-byte contexts, so valid page-end objects fault in native registration. SW auto-assignment has a second wide copy.
not_established: Actual guard placement and failure are unobserved.
remediation: Separate 97-byte-difference PE candidates bound every reviewed public PI copy. C1 local, C2 physical. USB/timer16 and the unknown private ABI are retained. The B10+B11 composition also executed.
